Membership Activities will normally begin as either a Lead or Emerging Risk\No Upside. LEAD should be chosen if there is the potential for upside. EMERGING RISK\NO UPSIDE should be chosen if there is no potential for upside. From there, the Membership Activity can progress to: PROPOSAL (RFP/Proposal is in-house or we are preparing a proactive proposal); IN REVIEW (RFP/ Proposal sent to customer); FINALIST (Named finalist or had finalist meeting) and NOTIFIED (Advised of final decision).

The transfer of Accounts between National Accounts and KA\UMR\URS will begin as a PENDING TRANSFER IN or PENDING TRANSFER OUT and will progress to TRANSFER IN/OUT, once the Transfer is Closed.
